page.content:
1204 sack of Constantinople by Latin crusaders.

How Fourth Crusade connects

  • Location: Constantinople — The Fourth Crusade sacked Constantinople in 1204.
  • Faction: Latin Empire — The crusade created the Latin Empire.

What is Fourth Crusade?

The Fourth Crusade diverted to Constantinople, sacked the city in 1204, and installed the Latin Empire — a wound the Palaiologoi only partly healed after 1261.

Key threads lead to Constantinople and Latin Empire.
